paths.description: Homepage and mandatory age-verification entry state, representing the initial public journey.
Popular listing, representing category and paginated result templates. Other listing categories were de-duplicated because they share this template.
One public media-detail URL, representing the playback/detail template. Playback was not started and age verification was not bypassed.
Search results for a neutral query, representing query and results behavior.
Login form, representing authentication and account entry.
Nonexistent route, representing HTTP failure and recovery behavior.

findings.summary: Theme does not follow the system color preference.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero prefers-color-scheme rules and color-scheme remained normal. Dark appearance is fixed/manual rather than preference-driven.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and map surfaces through prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), while retaining the manual override.

findings.summary: Motion continues when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, three 1200 ms animations remained running and the stylesheet contained zero reduced-motion rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion reduction layer that disables non-essential animation and transition effects.

findings.summary: The age-verification UI disappears under increased contrast.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast: more screenshot shows the backdrop and panel but no visible logo, text, or controls, making the primary gate unusable.
findings.suggestedFix: Use system colors or tested high-contrast tokens, preserve borders and text, and verify forced-colors and prefers-contrast states.

findings.summary: Long listings provide no scroll-position feedback.
findings.evidence: The 2,983 px mobile document has no progress or scroll-state-aware chrome; the platform probe found no container-query support and recon showed static navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight CSS scroll-state or scroll-progress affordance where it helps users orient in long listings.

findings.summary: Navigation changes do not visibly guide attention.
findings.evidence: Representative listing, search, and detail routes use full page changes without a current-location heading on the listing and search templates; their DOMs have no h1.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose a clear current-page heading and active navigation state; use directional transitions only where they clarify movement.

findings.summary: The mandatory overlay is a custom div rather than a complete modal primitive.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found div#ageVerificationModal role=dialog without aria-modal, plus a separate custom overlay. No native dialog was used.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog for the modal flow, with an accessible name, aria-modal behavior, focus trapping/restoration, and explicit exit paths.

findings.summary: Advertising and duplicated navigation compete with the content.
findings.evidence: The first load creates 16 third-party origins, ad widgets, duplicated desktop/mobile menus, and 2.59 MB of third-party transfer before the gate is completed.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay non-essential ads and duplicate chrome until after intent, and reserve the first viewport for the gate and primary content.

findings.summary: Reusable components rely on viewport styling only.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero container rules across loaded stylesheets although cards, headers, forms, and overlays are reused in different-width regions.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for reusable cards and form/header modules while keeping viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and many targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: The focus probe found outline-style none and no box shadow on the first 20 focusable controls. Many links were about 31 px high and Lighthouse failed target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible indicator and expand touch targets to at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels or equivalent spacing.

findings.summary: HTTP failure has no useful recovery path.
findings.evidence: A nonexistent route returned a bare nginx-style 404 with only a heading and no search, home link, explanation, or retry action.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404/error state with clear status, search/home recovery controls, and preserved navigation.

findings.summary: Mobile load performance and stability miss Core Web Vitals targets.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 13.5 s, CLS 0.278, FCP 4.7 s, and performance 0.42. The first-party mobile layout probe also measured CLS 0.142.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the true LCP resource, reserve all late content space, and defer third-party work until after primary rendering.

findings.summary: Late overlays and unsized images cause large layout shifts.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 11 shifts and CLS 0.278; the layout probe measured 0.142, including a 0.13 shift. All 33 inspected images lacked numeric dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Set valid width and height or aspect-ratio on media and reserve stable space for the gate, ads, and dynamic widgets.

findings.summary: Third-party and application script create substantial main-thread work.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded 2.8 s of main-thread work, including 783 ms script evaluation. The trace also found a 73 ms long task.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redundant analytics, defer non-critical scripts, and split long initialization tasks by priority.

findings.summary: The critical path includes blocking scripts and weak cache hygiene.
findings.evidence: HAR identified parser-inserted headerScripts and jQuery Tagify without async/defer, three blocking stylesheets, and resources without cache headers. The live DOM confirmed the head scripts are synchronous.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts, inline only minimal critical CSS, preload only verified LCP assets, and set durable immutable caching for versioned resources.

findings.summary: Repeated analytics and unused code inflate the load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed unused CSS and unused JavaScript. The DOM loaded four gtag/Analytics configurations plus another analytics bundle; scripts transferred 1.13 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate analytics to one configuration, remove duplicate libraries, and code-split route-specific CSS and JavaScript.

findings.summary: Controls and media lack accessible names and alternatives.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name, link-name, image-alt, and select-name. The image probe found 28 of 33 images without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every interactive control a discernible name, label selects and inputs, and add meaningful or empty alt text as appropriate.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails on primary and advertising UI.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found white text at 3.16:1 on the green age-verification CTA and 4.26:1 on red ad labels, below WCAG AA for normal text.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to at least 4.5:1 for normal text and test third-party widget themes too.

findings.summary: Landmarks, heading hierarchy, and visible focus are missing.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no main, nav, header, or footer landmarks and no h1 on the homepage/listing/detail templates. The focus probe showed no visible outline or box shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic page landmarks, one descriptive h1 per template, ordered headings, and a persistent :focus-visible style.

findings.summary: The mobile gate clips explanatory text.
findings.evidence: At 360 by 800, the fixed-height gate truncates the parent-safety paragraph behind the CTA while the desktop version shows more text.
findings.suggestedFix: Let the modal content scroll naturally, avoid fixed clipping, and keep readable line lengths and spacing at narrow widths.

findings.summary: The page prevents zoom and media lacks text alternatives.
findings.evidence: The viewport meta sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=0. Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and target-size, and the detail probe found no caption tracks on seven video elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove zoom restrictions, enlarge targets, and provide captions or equivalent transcripts for meaningful media.

findings.summary: The page logs a browser error during load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported a security console error: Not allowed to load local resource: blob:, attributed to the main document.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct or remove the invalid blob resource load and add regression monitoring for uncaught and console errors.

findings.summary: Image sizing and aspect-ratio handling are unsound.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image aspect ratio, responsive image sizing, and unsized images. The image probe found all 33 images missing width/height and 25 missing srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic dimensions, preserve aspect ratios, and provide responsive sources at appropriate densities.

findings.summary: Inspector and platform hygiene checks fail.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported inspector issues, legacy JavaScript, and a restricted zoom viewport. The page also uses javascript: links for language controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve DevTools inspector issues, remove legacy delivery where unnecessary, restore user scaling, and use real controls/URLs instead of javascript: links.

findings.summary: Metadata is not consistently descriptive across templates.
findings.evidence: The homepage title is a keyword list, while the sampled detail page had an empty meta description. Listing and login routes reused generic metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Create concise, unique titles and meta descriptions for homepage, listing, search, login, and detail templates.

findings.summary: Some controls are not crawlable and mobile metadata blocks scaling.
findings.evidence: Recon found javascript: language links and href=# controls, while the viewport disables user scaling. Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and several links lacked discernible names.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations or buttons for actions, descriptive link text, and a zoom-safe viewport declaration.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals are stale or missing.
findings.evidence: No canonical URL was found on the homepage probe. sitemap.xml returned 200 but its sampled lastmod values were all from 2018, despite currently changing listings.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit self-referencing canonicals on indexable templates and generate a current sitemap with truthful lastmod values.

findings.summary: Share metadata does not accurately represent every page.
findings.evidence: The homepage declares og:type video.movie and og:video pointing to the homepage URL with an empty duration, while the detail page has no meta description.
findings.suggestedFix: Use WebSite/Organization metadata on the homepage and accurate VideoObject/Open Graph values only on actual detail pages.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie attributes are absent.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy were all absent. All 13 first-party cookies lacked Secure, and sessionId lacked HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy; mark session cookies Secure, HttpOnly, and appropriately SameSite.

findings.summary: Tracking and third-party activity start before user intent.
findings.evidence: The gate load contacted 16 third-party origins and known Google trackers. HAR attributed 59 of 63 requests and 2.59 MB of 2.63 MB to third parties.
findings.suggestedFix: Hold analytics and advertising until lawful consent/intent, remove redundant trackers, and proxy or self-host essential resources where appropriate.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only.
findings.evidence: The login form exposes username and password fields, no WebAuthn or navigator.credentials integration was found, and no passkey option is presented.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkeys/WebAuthn as the preferred sign-in method with password fallback and contextual permission prompts only.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are not configured.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no HSTS, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, or CSP; all cookies were SameSite=None and non-Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, CSP frame-ancestors, strict referrer and permissions policies, then tighten cookie scope and SameSite behavior.

findings.summary: Network/HTTP failure states are not integrated with the site.
findings.evidence: The sampled nonexistent route rendered a bare server 404 without site navigation, search, retry, or explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Route 404 and recoverable network failures through a consistent, accessible error component with useful next steps.

findings.summary: Localization is visibly incomplete.
findings.evidence: Although html lang=en-GB is present, rendered navigation exposes untranslated keys such as header.category.newest and header.loginmenu.login across homepage recon.
findings.suggestedFix: Prevent raw translation keys from reaching users, add locale fallback tests, set dir explicitly when needed, and prefer logical CSS properties.

findings.summary: Advertising is visually mixed with site content and tracking starts behind the gate.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse identified ad-widget links with empty href values that are rewritten on mouse events, while the page starts advertising/tracking before age verification is completed.
findings.suggestedFix: Clearly label and separate ads, use honest stable destinations, and do not initialize behavioral advertising before valid consent and age-gate completion.

findings.summary: Login fields do not expose native validation state.
findings.evidence: The login probe found username and password fields labelled as required with an asterisk, but required=false and no aria-invalid/error relationship. This prevents consistent native and accessible feedback.
findings.suggestedFix: Use required and appropriate constraints, validate after interaction, and connect specific error messages with aria-describedby and live announcements.

findings.summary: Sign-in and search fields do not provide useful autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: The username and password fields have empty autocomplete attributes; search explicitly sets autocomplete=off.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=username and current-password (plus webauthn where supported), and avoid disabling autocomplete without a compelling reason.

findings.summary: Account entry lacks phishing-resistant authentication assistance.
findings.evidence: The sampled account entry offers only username/password with no passkey path, while sessionId is neither Secure nor HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkeys, secure the session lifecycle, and make account security, sign-out, and recovery controls clear and reversible.

findings.summary: Image delivery is not resolution or format efficient.
findings.evidence: Of 33 images, 29 used legacy formats, 25 lacked srcset, 18 below-fold images were not lazy, and 4 were oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP where suitable, use srcset/sizes, lazy-load below-fold media, and retain intrinsic dimensions.

findings.summary: Large non-essential work runs before the gate is completed.
findings.evidence: The initial gate load downloaded a 1.0 MB media asset, four analytics configurations, multiple ad providers, and 2.59 MB of third-party data before user intent.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not fetch media, ads, or analytics behind the blocking gate; start only the minimum verification UI and defer everything else.

findings.summary: Third-party and autoplay media cost is disproportionate to the entry state.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 98% of transferred bytes on the gate load, and the detail DOM contains four muted autoplay video elements without the primary media being started.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, remove redundant tags, lazy-load ad/media widgets, and avoid autoplay except for user-requested essential playback.

taskList.title: Stop third-party work before age verification and consent
Deploy security headers and secure cookie attributes
Fix semantic structure, names, focus, contrast, zoom, and captions
Stabilize and accelerate the first mobile load
Modernize metadata, URLs, sitemap, and recovery pages
Optimize responsive media and component layout
